Commentary.Commentary: Sharafuddin Ashraf is down for a chat. He says that he feels good contributing with the wickets as they have world class bowlers in their side. On chasing the target and then being asked about the wicket he says that the track is flat and the players are high on confidence after some good bowling. Ends by saying that if they get a good partnership at the top, they will chase the target.

The Windies will be disappointed with themselves. They never had any partnerships going, and the two 50-stands which came to be, took a lot of time to form. Shai Hope in particular could be held accountable as he never really got going and scored at a slow rate. Jason Holder came in, was playing briskly, but got out soon after. Now, it won't be an easy task to stop the Afghans, but a couple of early wickets and you never know. Join in for the run chase in just a bit.

A good bowling performance from the Afghans as they've restricted the Windies to under 200. They started off by picking wickets, but more than anything, where they were successful was that they never let the opposition score runs freely. Clogged the scoring rate, built pressure and sooner rather than later, got wickets at regular intervals. All the spinners got a piece of the action, with Mujeeb Ur Rahman taking a 3-fer and Mohammad Nabi taking 2. It was a good outing in the field for them.

Short ball outside off, Ashley Nurse looks to scoop it over the keeper's head but gets hit maybe on the shoulder. But the umpire signals a run so there might have been some bat involved. It rolls away behind square on the off side and a quick single is taken. WEST INDIES FINISH ON 197/8!
Short and angling in, pulled away over square leg. One run is stolen by the batsmen as the man in the deep mops it up.
Excellent bowling. In the blockhole, tailing in on leg, raps Nurse low on the pads and goes on the off side. Leg bye taken.
Short ball outside off, Paul with a swing and a miss. Nurse sets off for the run as Shahzad aims for the stumps at his end. Misses, poor attempt really. Good running though.
Keemo Paul to have a change of bats.
SIX! That's a big hit! Windies can use all they can get. Full and in the slot, Keemo Paul slogs it high and mighty over mid-wicket for a maximum.
The catch is taken but it won't matter. Full and outside off, Nurse slices this towards deep backward point where Naib pouches it. Single taken.
Free Hit coming up...
No ball! High full toss around off, hit down to long on for a single. The umpire signals no ball for height.
Dawlat Zadran to bowl the last over of the innings.
Driven down to long off for a single.
Spinning in, on middle and leg, hit on the pads as he tried to sweep.
Full and attacking the stumps, hit straight back to the bowler.
The ball hits the batsman low on the pads. The batsmen have run through for a single. Leg byes given by the umpire.
Nudges this 'round the corner and picks up a single as a result.
Some extra bounce on this occasion. Beats the edge and thuds into the gloves of the keeper.
Quicker on the stumps, goes off the inside edge on the leg side. A good spell from the skipper comes to an end. He finishes with figures of 10-1-31-1.
Another one ripping away, it's past the edge and beats the attempted flick.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Leg break on off, landed on a driving length, Nurse is forward in defense and gets beaten.
The wrong 'un, played with the spin into the leg side for one run.
Looped leg break on middle stump, driven down the ground, towards long on. Single taken.
Rashid Khan will have a change of ends.
Short ball sliding across, Keemo Paul goes back and whips this through mid-wicket. Runs the first one hard so is able to come back for the second easily. Good running.
Similar ball, similar shot. Same number of runs taken.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Straighter in line once again, another nudge and one more to the total.
Flatter ball on middle and leg, worked away through backward square leg. Single taken.
Comes from around the wicket and attacks the stumps, worked away square on the leg side for a side.
Mohammad Nabi to bowl.
Short and wide, it's cut hard but straight to backward point.
Knocks it into the covers and crosses over.

Doesn't look like there's going be a leg before given today. This is quite close as well. Quicker one on middle and leg, catches Paul who's stuck deep inside his crease. The umpire maybe feels height is the issue.

One more lbw appeal, which is disallowed. Tossed up around off, it's drifting in as Paul steps out to play. It catches his pads but the appeal is ignored. Probably because he was too far down the track.
Sliding into the batsman, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Spinning away on a bit of a shorter length, slapped off the back foot through covers for a double.
Works it to point. Dot ball to end the over.
Keemo Paul, the debutant, will bat now.
OUT! Catching practice for the Afghans! Tossed up, Powell gets low and sweeps it aerially. Straight into the hands of Mujeeb Ur Rahman who takes it with ease at deep square leg.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side.
Plays with the turn and dabs it to backward point.
Hasn't picked this one either. The leg break this time, Powell looks to flick it on the leg side but gets a leading edge towards point.

Oooh... that was close! Impact the issue here. Immediately starts off with the googly as he tosses it up around off, it spins back in and catches Powell on the front pad. The umpire turns down the appeal. Rashid Khan is surprised how that's not been given out. Smiles at the end of it though.
Rashid Khan is back.
Goes inside out with this, lofts it over covers with the spin and comes back for the second.
Wrists this full ball to long on and gets off strike with a single.
Slower through the air outside off, Nurse comes forward and blocks it down safely.
Ashley Nurse will bat next.

OUT! Another wicket down for the Windies! Tossed up again, Brathwaite once again goes for the slog sweep but top edges it this time. It balloons up and goes towards Rahmat Shah at deep square leg, where he takes a simple catch.
FOUR! That's a good shot! Fraction straight in line, slightly fuller in length, which allows Brathwaite to kneel forward and across and sweep it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Quite full and in line of the stumps, the batsman comes forward and wristily flicks it through mid-wicket.
Sharafuddin Ashraf to bowl again.
Quicker leg break outside off, Carlos takes a big stride forward before defending it down on the off side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Wrong 'un dropped short and outside off, turns back in as Brathwaite goes deep inside the crease to defend.
Carlos Brathwaite is next in.

OUT! HOPE DEPARTS! Wanted to up the ante and score the big ones, walks back in that quest. Tossed up on off, Shai kneels down and slogs it towards long on. Najibullah runs to his left and takes a good catch. That brings an end to a rather snail-paced knock from Shai Hope.
Short and outside off, no spin on it, Powell punches it down to long on for a single.
Outside off, quite full in length, the batsman drags the sweep through to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Drives it through mid off and takes one to end the over.
Comes half-forward to this fuller length delivery and meets it with the full face of the bat.

Stifled appeal for Shahzad but nothing from the umpire. Spinning away from outside off, Hope plays for it only to get beaten. The keeper appeals, but pretty sure even he know he's not going to get anything from the umpire.
Wide outside off, no real spin on this one, Hope kneels down to sweep it away but misses to connect.
Leg spinner on middle and off, Hope is well forward in defense.
Pushed quicker through the air outside off, beats the edge easily.
Terrific over comes to an end. Outside off, turns and squares Powell up. Beats the edge as it goes into the keeper's gloves.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Big shout for a leg before! The inside edge saves him though. Googly which spins back in, catches Powell's pads but not before taking the inside edge. Would have been gone otherwise. Lucky.
Rovman Powell is next in.

OUT! Another solid partnership is broken the moment is was looking promising. Fuller on the stumps, Holder goes downtown, looking to clear long on. Not enough height on it and it's straight down the throat of Najibullah who makes no mistake.
The 50-run stand is up. These two need to carry on. Swept away on the leg side for another run.
Short and flat, swatted to long off for one.
Powerplay 3 signalled. A maximum 0f 5 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the end of the innings.
Stays right behind the line and guards it out solidly.
Comes forward and blocks it out off the front foot.
Absolute ripper from Rashid Khan! Lands it around off and makes it go away from Shai Hope. The batsman can only hang his bat and thank his stars he didn't edge it.
A big lunge forward and a simple drive down to long off. Single taken.
Holder plays for the straighter one but it turns away. Beats the outside edge and thuds into the keeper's gloves.
Floats it right up there, played to mid on for no run.
Rashid Khan brings himself back on.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Holder drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Worked away into the leg side again. Dot ball.
Almost! Holder could have been gone. Short and spinning in, Holder goes back and whips it aerially towards short mid-wicket. It falls just short of the fielder there.
Short and flat around off, flat-batted to long on to rotate strike.
Tossed up on middle and off, hit to long on. One run added to the total.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman comes back on.
Full and attacking the stumps, played through mid on for a single.
Nice, controlled pull from Shai Hope. Places it along the ground towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Offers some width outside off, it's hit to point. Straight to the fielder so no run taken.
Short and outside off, crashed through the covers for a couple of runs.
Marginally ahead of a length, attacking the stumps, a solid punch down to long on earns Jason Holder a single.

Full and straight from Dawlat, Holder hits it back to the bowler who throws it back at the striker's end and scores a direct hit. No harm done, the Windies skipper is well inside the crease. Holder didn't take the run off the ricochet because the ball first went off him before hitting the stumps.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
The ball was hit big by Holder. It's lost and hence a replacement is brought in.
SIX! Gets hold of this one! Tossed up ball, Holder slog sweeps this over mid-wicket for the first biggie of the game. Windies badly needs more of this.
Short ball, hope rocks back and punches this through mid on for a run.
Wide! But a stumping chance goes begging. Nabi sees Holder charging and fires this down the leg. Holder misses the ball and so does the keeper. The ball goes to fine leg and they pick up a run.
Hits this straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Gets this past mid-wicket for a run.
Hope works this off his pads behind square.
Excellent ball to bowl the free hit. Zadran yorks Hope and does not allow him to free his arms. Hope does well to get his bat down in time. The ball goes towards mid-wicket and they pick up a run.
Free Hit coming up... Third man and fine leg come up.
No ball! For a full toss above waist height. Holder taps it through mid-wicket for one. Zadran immediately apologises to Holder after the ball.
Back of a length ball, Hope goes back and pushes this to mid on for one more.
In line of the stumps, Hope defends this of his back foot.
Holder gets this past point for a run.
Wide. Short ball down the leg, Holder goes for the pull but misses. The keeper gets excited but the umpire extends his arms to signal a wide.
Around off, hope opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man for to rotate strike.
Starts off bowling one on the pads of Holder who flicks it away to give Hope strike.
Dawlat Zadran comes for his second spell from the other end.
The second drinks break has been taken on the field.
Played to the point region by Hope.
On middle and leg, Hope plays it towards mid-wicket.
Hope flicks this to the square leg fielder.
Another shot played in the same region. A yes-no from the batsmen but Hope gets  in, in time.
Gets it past the man at mid-wicket this time. They pick up a run.
Hits this to the fielder at mid-wicket.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries to end the over! This will please and provide some much-needed relief to the Windies. Jason Holder takes a big stride forward, gets close to the pitch of the ball and firmly drives it through the covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Rashid Khan throws this wide outside off, Holder uses the width and crashes it square past point for a boundary.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Flat, short and outside off, Shai Hope forces the punch through the cover region and takes one.
The wrong 'un which spins into the batsman, Hope works it towards mid-wicket.
Leans ahead to the full ball and knocks it through mid on for one.
A brace to end the over. Manipulates the ball in front of square leg and come back for the second.
Shorter outside off, it's tapped in front of point. Looks for the single but doesn't get it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Uses the depth of the crease well to block this away from danger.
Leading edge which falls safely. Jason Holder is a lucky man. It's full around his pads, he closes the face early and spoons the edge over the bowler's head. Single taken.
Worked away to mid-wicket again. No run this time.
Short and flat, going on straight, whipped off the back foot through the mid-wicket area for a single.
Another drive, this time down to long on. Just a single this time.
Pitches it up, outside the off stump, Hope leans into the shot and drives it through towards sweeper cover. Picks up two runs for doing so.

Shahzad appeals loudly for a caught behind but nothing from the umpire. Flighted leg break outside off, Hope goes after it and is beaten past the edge. The umpire doesn't think there's an edge so shuts the appeal down.
Stays deep inside his crease and keeps it out safely.
Flatter delivery just outside off, Hope meets it with the full face of the bat.
Hope drives this to covers to retain strike.
The skipper, Jason Holder, is the new batsman in.

OUT! Just when we thought that the Windies will now step on the gas after a good partnership, they lose another wicket, yet again. Short ball, Samuels pulls this over mid-wicket but doesn't get enough distance to go all the way. Gulbadin Naib, hares from deep square leg to his left and takes a very good catch. A wicket for Afghanistan just at the right time. Windies will now have to build another partnership.
Gets this past mid on, as they change ends.
Hope works this to mid on.
Short ball, Samuels pulls this in front of square on the leg side for a run.
Defended off the back foot by Samuels.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Beauty from Rashid. Bowls a wrong one around off and it spins back into Samuels. He goes for a forward defense but is beaten.
Tossed up, Samuels hits it down the ground.
Hope flicks this off his pads to square leg for one.
Hope drives this back to the bowler.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Rashid Khan gets a change of ends.

Flat again on off, Samuels pushes this to the off side for a run. With this brings the 50-run stand between these two. It's come off 99 balls. Good build up from the two. They now need to play a little faster.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Finally a short ball has been punished. Half tracker from Nabi, Samuels pulls this over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short again, Hope rocks back and punches the ball on the on side to rotate strike.
Short ball, Samuels pulls this to deep mid-wicket but for just one.
Darts this on the pads of Hope. He flicks this to square leg for one.
Mohammad Nabi comes back to bowl.
Drifting into Hope who flicks it away for a run to end the over. Spin from both ends is making Windies struggle to make runs.
Pitched up, Hope gets forward and drives it to covers.
Around off, Hope gives it to the fielder at point.
Tossed up, Hope pushes this for the cover fielder to collect.
Outside off, Hope plays it to point.
That's more like it. Good intent shown by Samuels. Comes down the track and hits it to long on for a run.

LOUD LBW SHOUT! But the umpire remains unmoved. Is this out though? Looks like it to the naked eye, but maybe, just maybe, the impact is just outside the line of off stump. It's so close though. It's the googly again, around off, catches Hope by surprise who moves across to defend. Is caught on the pads and the Afghans go up in a loud appeal. Deary me... have to feel for the umpire. Has only a split second to make the call and the margin is so less. Hope survives, that's the end of the over.
Googly from the leggie, it's punched to long off. One more run to the total.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Wide! Darted well outside off, turning away, goes across the tramline and so, the umpire signals a wide.
Full and spinning away, nice loop on it, eased back down to long off. Single taken.
Looped right up there, just around off, Hope drives it down the ground for a single.
Full and outside off, driven off the outer half square on the off side.
Defended off the front foot by Samuels presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman drives this through the covers for a single.
After too many dot balls, Samuels dances down and looks to loft this one. The ball takes a thick edge and goes towards wide third man. They manage to come back for the third run.
Samuels has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Hope cuts it through point and moves to the other end.
Hope defends this from within the crease.
Outside off, Samuels plays this to the point region.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
In line of the stumps, Marlon hits it back to the bowler.
Samuels cuts this from the outer half of the bat to the point fielder.
Around off, Samuels strides forward and looks to drive this but gets an inside edge to it. The ball goes past the leg pole and towards fine leg. They cross for two.
Pitched up ball, Hope drives this through mid off for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Short ball, in line of the stumps, Samuels dances down the track and blocks this again.
Around off, Samuels blocks this.
Samuels defends this getting behind the ball.
Slower through the air again, Samuels gets to the pitch of the ball and hits it through mid on for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, Samuels dances down but decides to block it.
Quicker ball, Hope covers his stumps, and blocks this.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Darts this outside off again, Marlon cannot find the gap this time. Gives it to the point fielder.
Outside off, Hope cuts it through backward point for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Starts off with a googly. Hope fails to put bat on ball.
Rashid Khan to finally bowl his first over.
FOUR! Ashraf kept it tight until this time. Overpitches this and Samuels hits it back past the bowler along the turf for a boundary.
The batsman has played the square drive. One run added to the total.
Hope drives it superbly to covers.
Outside off, Hope cuts it to backward point. The ball goes through the hands of the fielder stationed there and they pick up two runs.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Quicker one in line of the stumps, Hope defends it.
Floats it up outside off, driven through mid on to keep strike.
Stays back, waits for the ball to come before punching it to long off. One more run added to the scoreboard.
Dropped short, allows Hope to go back and pull it along the ground to deep square leg for a single.
Quicker one and it's the off break this time. Hope can't pick him and as a result gets caught on the pads. Luckily for him, it was going down leg.
Turning away after landing around off, Shai Hope opens the face and dabs it to point.
Straighter one on off, Hope shuffles across and defends after getting behind the line.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. maiden over for Ashraf.
Straighter one, Samuels gets forward and blocks it. The players appeal but this time the umpire notices the inside edge.
Samuels has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Marlon punches this to covers for nothing.
Outside off, Samuels cuts it to the fielder at point.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Floated ball, Hope drives it superbly to covers.
Hope flicks this to the square leg fielder to collect.
Outside off, Hope cuts it to the point fielder.
Driven towards mid on.
Outside off, Samuels gets an edge on the off side and they pick up one more.
Toosed up, Hope gets forward and pushes this through covers for a run.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman comes back into the attack.
Marlon drives this to mid off to end the over.

NOT OUT! Tossed up, outside off. Samuels gets low and goes for the big drive. He misses it and the keeper takes the bails off in a flash. Keeper appeals and the square leg umpire is not sure as he takes it up. However, on seeing the replays, Samuels has brought his back foot back in time.
Another stumping appeal has been taken up. Looks like Samuels has brought his back foot in time. Let's see...
Driven towards the mid off region.
Hope drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Slower through the air, Hope gets behind the ball and defends it.
Around off, Hope eases it on the off side to retain strike.
Floated ball, in line of the stumps, Hope blocks it.
Short again, Samuels pushes it down the ground to rotate strike.
Tossed up, Hope plays it through mid on for one more.
Hope shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Short ball, Samuels punches this on the off side for one.
Mohammad Nabi gets a change of ends.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Samuels hits this to mid-wicket and quickly moves to the other end. Rashid Khan collects it and quickly gets rid of it. Goes for a direct hit at the bowler's end but misses. Single completed.
Played to the point region by Samuels.
Marlon plays this to mid on.
Tossed up, Samuels gets his front foot ahead and blocks it.
Gives this some air, Hope drives it through covers for a run.
Sharafuddin Ashraf to roll his arm now.
Drinks break!
Guided down to third man, rather comfortably and the over ends with a single.
Quite far away outside off, no shot offered on this occasion.
Shaping away from around off, some movement off the seam as Hope looks to run it down with an open face. Misses as he's beaten past the outside edge.
Low dipping full toss outside off, hit through the covers. One more run taken.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven through covers for one.
Short and wide outside off, Hope cracks this straight to point. Najibullah there has a shy at the bowler's end and scores a direct hit. Powerful throw, the middle stump went for a long cartwheel.
Tossed up, Marlon covers his timber and blocks it. Maiden over from Nabi.
Samuels plays this to the fielder at mid on to collect.
Samuels defends this in his crease.
Marlon shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Samuels cuts this to the fielder at point.
Samuels gets an inside edge trying play it on the off side. The ball hits him on the pads.
Outside off, Hope leaves it alone.
Wide. The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman. The umpire signals a wide.
Shai Hope strides out to the center.

OUT! Evin Lewis is a goner! And it's all due to some excellent work from Najibullah Zadran. Outside off, Samuels cuts it to backward point and responds to his partner's call. Lewis doesn't run in a straight line and almost loses hope. Zadran moves to his left and hits the timber. Lewis is nowhere close to the crease and has to continue walking to the hut. Big wicket this for the men in blue as Lewis can be dangerous later on.
Pitched up, Samuels hits this hard through covers for a brace.
Outside off, chooses to leave the ball.
Slow ball outside off, Samuels tries to slap this on the off side but only manages to get a bottom edge to the keeper.
Short ball, Lewis pulls this through mid-wicket for just one.
Just short. Was in the air for a brief period but fell short of the fielder at cover. Samuels went a little early into the cover drive and almost got caught out.
Shorter in length and outside off, cut away square on the off side for two more.
Makes connection this time, width offered outside off, it's run down towards third man for a couple.
Bit quicker through the air, outside off, Samuels is beaten for pace as he looks to cut this away.
Straighter one outside off, played to point by Samuels for no run.
Marlon Samuels is the next batsman in.

OUT! Mohammad Nabi strikes gold with his very first ball of the game! What a moment. But, there's an inside edge which the umpire has missed. Oh, how Hetmyer would have liked the review here. Nabi comes from around the wicket and gives it some nice flight around off, it comes in with the drift and catches the front pad of the batsman. Loud shout and the finger goes up. He looks disappointed and the replays rolling in show why. There's an inside edge before the ball hit the pad. In any case, Afghanistan rejoice. This is a big moment for Mohammad Nabi as well, he becomes the first Afghan player to reach 100 ODI wickets. Superb achievement.
Mohammad Nabi to bowl from the other end.
Targeting the top of off stump, Lewis positions himself perfectly behind the line and blocks it out with a straight blade.
Wide! Angling down the leg side, the batsman looks to get some bat on it but misses.
Outside off on a good length, dabbed to point for an easy run.
Straying on the pads, Shimron works it to the left of mid-wicket, but the fielder is quick to get to the ball.
Another short ball, another pull. This time to deep backward square leg. One run taken.
Just ahead of a length, outside off, Lewis checks his drive while playing it in front of cover.
Short ball banged in from around the wicket, angling in, Hetmyer pulls it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Gulbadin Naib will bowl his first over.
Powerplay two has been signalled by the umpire.  A maximum of four fielders can now be outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Flat and short, Lewis cuts this to the deep point for two runs.
Lewis flicks this to square leg.
Tossed up, Lewis plays this to mid on.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Elegantly done by Hetmyer. Outside off, Shimron opens the face of the bat and plays it to third man for a boundary.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Outside off, Lewis fails to put bat on ball.

FOUR! Almost chops it on! Around off, too close to cut. Lewis goes on his back foot and tries to slap this through the offside. The ball takes the inside edge, goes past the off pole and races away to the fine leg boundary.
FOUR! Good looking short from Lewis. Back of a length ball, Lewis whips this through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Lewis drives this superbly to covers.
Outside off, Hetmyer cuts it to third man for one.
Short ball, Hetmyer pulls it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Much needed for the Windies. Mujeeb bowls this on leg, Lewis gets in position and places it between square leg and short fine leg for a boundary.
Wide. The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Hetmyer shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Tossed up, Hetmyer flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Outside off, Hetmyer gets beaten as he plays along the wrong line.
Driven through mid-off by Hetmyer.
ANOTHER PEACH! Outside off, swings away from Lewis and he is beaten once more trying to block it.

Great bowling from Zadran. He is making Lewis play at these. Another teasing ball around off, Lewis looks to fiddle with it but gets beaten. The ball goes to the keeper and the players go up in unison. There was a sound but that must have been of the bat hitting the thigh-pad flap.
Outside off, Lewis shoulders arms to this one.
Outside off, moves away from Lewis who tries going hard at it. He misses his cut and the ball settles in the gloves of Shai Hope.
Leg bye. On the pads of Hetmyer, he looks to work it on its way but misses it. The ball hits his pad and goes on the leg side as they steal a run.
Length around off, Hetmyer taps it in front of him.
Floats this around off, the ball spins into Lewis and hits him on the thigh pad as he tries to whip it.
Pushed towards covers by Lewis.
Tossed up, Lewis watchfully blocks it.
Evin has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short ball, Lewis goes for the pull but misses it.
Lewis plays this to mid-wicket.
Well left. It's slanting across on a good length, Hetmyer watches the ball till the last second before letting it be.
Fullish in length this time, on the fourth stump line, a firm punch offered to mid off by the batsman.
Moves a step across to this one, defends it with a closed face towards mid-wicket.
Banged in short again, once more quite close to the off stick, Lewis is on his toes to cut it away but gets it off the bottom edge on the leg side for a single.
Gets it in the gap. It's on the shorter side of the length close to off, Hetmyer with an angled bat cuts it past point and comes back for the third due to some good running.
Serves it on a good length, well outside the line of off stump, Hetmyer prods forward and shoulders arms to it.
NOT OUT! Outside off, Lewis goes for the sweep and loses his balance in doing so. The keeper removes the bails but Evin has not raised his foot. The replays confirm that.
A stumping appeal has been referred. Lewis has just lost his balance trying to sweep. He looks confident though.
Another wrong 'un. Lewis is beaten outside his off stump.
Evin has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single. Hetmyer gets off the mark.
Shimron Hetmyer walks in next.

OUT! What a brilliant piece of bowling! The 16-year old has just managed to fox the big man. Darts this on middle and leg, Gayle doesn't read the googly and plays the wrong line. The ball goes past his outside edge and removes the off stump from its root. Afghanistan get the big fish. Just the start they were looking for.
Lewis drives this through mid off, they pick up a run.
On the legs of Chris, and the ball hits him low on the pads.
Outside off, Gayle looks to flirt with it but gets beaten.
Short ball, Gayle goes for the pull but misses it completely.
Lewis works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Follows it up with a yorker. Lewis digs it out in time.

FOUR! Edged and away! There was a second slip in the first over and he has been removed for this one. Had he been there, this would have been a simple catch for him. Serves this around off, Lewis pokes at it and the ball races away to the third man region for a boundary.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Pitched up, Lewis eases this through mid on for a run.
Great ball. Gets sharp turn on it. Pitches this around off and spins back into Lewis, catching him on the pads. Strong appeal from the bowlers but the umpire stays put.
Better length from Mujeeb, in line of the stumps and Lewis blocks it.
Third umpire has been referred for a run out appeal. Looks like the batsman has made his crease as no Afghan player looks interested.

Short ball again, Lewis pushes this through mid on for a brace. Gayle strolls to make his ground and the bowler has managed to take the bails out at the non-striker's end. The umpire goes up but the big man is comfortably in.
Wide. The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Short ball, Lewis rocks back and taps it on the off side.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman will bowl from the other end.
Length ball in line of the stumps, Gayle defends this with a straight bat. Good start for Zadran just two off the first over.
Back of a length again, Lewis punches this on the off side for his first run.
Back of a length delivery, Lewis goes on his back foot and blocks it.
Pitched just ahead of that good length area. Gayle looks to flick this on the on side but gets a leading edge to it. The ball goes to the deep point area and they pick up their first run of the day.
Length around off, Gayle watchfully defends it.
Starts off with a length ball on that fourth stump line, Gayle doesn't move his feet and the ball just passes his outside edge. Good start for Zadran.

We are done and dusted with that. Now time for the game to begin. Chris Gayle and Evin Lewis will open the innings for the Windies. There are two slips in place for Dawlat Zadran who will open the bowling. He has some problem with the sightscreen behind, so makes adjustments to that. Ready to begin now. Here we go...
Time for the National Anthems. First, we will begin with Afghanistan's followed by the Windies'.
Windies XI - Chris Gayle, Evin Lewis, Shimron Hetmyer, Marlon Samuels, Shai Hope(w), Jason Holder(c), Rovman Powell, Carlos Brathwaite, Ashley Nurse, Keemo Paul, Nikita Miller.

Afghanistan XI - Mohammad Shahzad(w), Javed Ahmadi, Rahmat Shah, Najibullah Zadran, Samiullah Shenwari, Mohammad Nabi, Sharafuddin Ashraf, Rashid Khan(c), Gulbadin Naib, Dawlat Zadran, Mujeeb Ur Rahman.

Pitch Report - Mark Butcher says the groundstaff has managed to get a beautiful shine on it. Adds there are hairline cracks on it. Further adds deciding to bat first is a good decision as it will turn in the latter stages of the game. Ends saying Rashid Khan will get a lot of turn and the other bowlers will have to work hard.

Rashid Khan says they didn't play well in the first half and want to play good here now. Adds they want to show how good they are. Continues saying they have learned from their mistakes and want to do better this time around. States everyone has been working hard and is ready for the challenge and they want to take it as a fresh tournament from this point on. Ends saying there are two changes as Mohammad Shahzad and Dawlat Zadran come in for Shapoor Zadran and Afsar Zazai.

Jason Holder says it looks a good wicket and wants to put runs on the board. Also says he wants today's game to be perfect and tick all the boxes. On changes, he mentions there are forced ones as Kemar Roach is out and Keemo Paul makes his debut and Nikita Miller is also in.
TOSS - Windies win the toss and elect to bat first!

Hello and welcome to the first match of the Super Six clash for a ticket to the ICC World Cup 2019. Table-toppers Windies and Afghanistan lock horns here at the Harare Sports Club. The team in maroon are in great form in this competition and are yet to taste defeat. They will hope that their in-form men come good today and maintain their 100 percent record. Afghanistan on the flip side, are very lucky to be in this position. After losing their first two games they were handed a big lifeline by Nepal. They will hope that they do not repeat their mistakes and try to start fresh. It's going to be a cracker of a game as both teams are favorites to go ahead in the competition. Toss and team news to follow.
